name: 648. Chat prompt-cache fields reach a custom provider as sent; a compatible vendor refuses the price-tier ones (chat cache fields)
description: Local fixture regression for TXE-7063 (Bifrost–Tokun contract C4, agreement three), no live provider calls. Start tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs, start an isolated gateway on tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, and run with providerErrorFixture=1; every case is skipped otherwise. Before TXE-7063 the OpenAI-shape chat converter removed prompt_cache_key, prompt_cache_retention and prompt_cache_options for the openai-based custom provider cp_plain (it falls into the converter's default case) and for every compatible vendor, without telling the caller. 648.2 sends all three to cp_plain and reads from GET /__wire that the vendor received each as sent. 648.3 and 648.4 send prompt_cache_retention (unary) and prompt_cache_options (streamed) to MiniMax, whose catalog lists neither: each is refused with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming the field, and /__wire shows no call. prompt_cache_key alone on a vendor with no cache key is the documented exemption (removed, not refused); core's TestChatConverterNeverDropsAPriceFieldSilently and TestGroqChatRefusesPriceTierCacheFieldsWithNoUpstreamCall cover it.

item.name: 648.1 fixture counters and recorded requests reset
648.2 the openai-based custom provider cp_plain receives prompt_cache_key, prompt_cache_retention and prompt_cache_options as sent (chat cache fields)

exec: pm.test('the request succeeded', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('the fixture reports what reached it', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); });
var calls = res.json().data[0].calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/pp/cp/v1/chat/completions' && c.body.indexOf('txe-7063-cache-fields') !== -1; });
pm.test('one request reached the vendor', function () { pm.expect(calls.length, res.text()).to.equal(1); });
pm.test('prompt_cache_key reached the vendor', function () { pm.expect(sent.prompt_cache_key, calls[0].body).to.equal('tenant-42'); });
pm.test('prompt_cache_retention reached the vendor', function () { pm.expect(sent.prompt_cache_retention, calls[0].body).to.equal('24h'); });
pm.test('prompt_cache_options reached the vendor', function () { pm.expect((sent.prompt_cache_options || {}).ttl, calls[0].body).to.equal('1h'); });

item.name: 648.3 [EXPECT-400] MiniMax refuses prompt_cache_retention with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter and makes no upstream call (chat cache fields)

exec: pm.test('the fixture reports what reached it', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); });
var calls = res.json().data[0].calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path === '/pp/minimax/v1/chat/completions' && c.body.indexOf('txe-7063-retention') !== -1; });
pm.test('nothing reached the vendor', function () { pm.expect(calls.length, res.text()).to.equal(0); });
